verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's own docs say its Unified Payments API connects to all payment methods through a single integration, and that Flow takes payments 'all through one simple integration'. Its payment-methods page promises access to 'all the local payment methods, digital wallets, and global card schemes'; Google Pay is named only in the Google AI agentic-commerce context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Apple Pay, bank-redirect methods and BNPL providers in the standard integration, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
